text:
omar: Quick heads up  CarbonAI just pinged about redistributing their 30B open weights on cloud marketplaces. They want a staggered rollout: first to a select list of marketplaces for 90 days, then wider. Also asking for a clause to allow partners to create "research-only" forks.
tina: link to their note: https://drive.redwood/carbon/carbon-release-notes-v1
raj_legal: initial reaction: "research-only" forks are fine only if we clearly define downstream commercial use. We need to ensure our Marketplace customers aren't allowed to take the model and commercialize a derivative without approval.
eng-ops-bot: infra flags: Carbon's checkpoint is ~72GB fp16. Hosting the pristine checkpoint in Redwood Hosted will be expensive; we should insist on using a deployment-optimized derivative (8-bit or quantized float) for Hosted SKU, while Dedicated customers can request pristine weights under contract.
tina: Commercial: Carbon proposes 25% revenue share for initial 90-day exclusivity, then 15% thereafter. They also want co-marketing support and joint webinars.
raj_legal: I recommend we counter with: exclusivity window limited to 60 days max, platform fee at 18% for exclusivity period, 12% thereafter, and we accept "research-only" fork language but define "research" as non-commercial internal research and not for customer resale. Also add export compliance warranty, and require partners to provide notarized provenance for the checkpoint.
omar: ops question: how do we support exclusivity technically? We need a private flag on listing and a marketplace ACL restricting visibility to specific partner accounts. That is doable but will need product support.
partners-bot: Created ticket PM-465: "CarbonAI marketplace term negotiation" assigned to tina, due in 6 business days.
tina: Next steps: 1) Legal to send counter (raj) 2) Eng to specify hosting/quantization options and pricing impact (omar) 3) Partnerships to negotiate co-marketing terms and exclusivity period (tina).
raj_legal: I'll draft a tracked redline and circulate.
omar: I'll produce a quick cost delta for hosting pristine vs quantized and post in this thread.
tina: Also confirming whether Carbon needs a press embargo. They did not request one yet but asked to be notified before any customer case studies are published.
eng-ops-bot: Note: if partner insists on research forks, we need a CLA-like agreement capturing permitted usage and a signed recipient list for any forks distributed.
omar: tagging product: we might need a UI flag for "restricted rollout" and ACL management. I'll open a wishlist ticket if legal counters and Carbon insists.
tina: Okay team, let's keep this moving. If folks see larger policy conflicts, escalate to partnerships leadership. :wave:
